> ⚠️ **IMPORTANT SECURITY NOTICE**
> If this is a critical security vulnerability involving leaked data, secrets, or remote code execution, please do **NOT** open a public issue.
> Contact the security team directly at **security@ebda-edu.eg** or through private vulnerability reporting.

**Vulnerability Summary**
High-level summary of the vulnerability without disclosing exploit payloads.

**Affected Area**
- [ ] Authentication / Session Management
- [ ] Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) & Permissions
- [ ] Teaching Records & Parent Data Privacy
- [ ] File Uploads & Material Link Sanitization
- [ ] API Endpoint & Payload Validation

**Impact Assessment**
Describe how this could impact school data or operations.
